{"id":1886566879,"question_id":3250,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768548039,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"2135 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1886566879/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Square Area by Removing Fences From a Field","memory":"282.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n    int maximizeSquareArea(int m, int n, vector<int>& hFences, vector<int>& vFences) {\n        vector<int>newh = hFences;\n        vector<int>newv = vFences;\n        int maxside = 0;\n\n        newh.push_back(1);\n        newh.push_back(m);\n        newv.push_back(1);\n        newv.push_back(n);\n\n        sort(newh.begin() , newh.end());\n        sort(newv.begin() , newv.end());\n\n        set<int>st;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i < newh.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =i+1 ; j<newh.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                st.insert(newh[j] - newh[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i < newv.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j =i+1 ; j<newv.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                int vgap = newv[j] - newv[i];\n                if(st.count(vgap))\n                {\n                    maxside = max(maxside , vgap);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if(maxside == 0) return -1;\n        else return (1LL * maxside * maxside) % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-square-area-by-removing-fences-from-a-field","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1498}
